cases.prompt: Target: products/standalone/termux/tools/migration_validator.py. Owner: product:termux. Guideline: docs/TERMUX_DEVELOPMENT_GUIDELINES.md. Contract evidence: products/standalone/termux/tools/README.md and products/standalone/termux/tools/tests/test_migration_validator.py. Result vocabulary: PASS/WARN/FAIL/UNKNOWN. Claim: review only path/ref input hardening for the current read-only migration validator, including malformed refs and hostile path text, without changing its owner or adding a writer.
cases.expected_output: A read-only static hardening review that proposes the applicable adversarial matrix from current source/contract evidence, explicitly states that no owner tests or adversarial cases were executed on this surface, preserves all unresolved execution evidence, and returns review disposition PARTIAL unless the requested claim is already completely provable without execution. A bounded hardening review that covers malformed and ambiguous path/ref classes, preserves owner-defined FAIL versus UNKNOWN semantics, and performs no mutation.
assertions: Proposes checks for empty/whitespace, NUL/control characters, Unicode surrogate or normalization-sensitive input.
Proposes checks for absolute, traversal, non-canonical, separator/platform variants and option-like refs.
Distinguishes character limits from encoded-byte or path-component ceilings when owner-defined.
Keeps missing or ambiguous evidence UNKNOWN rather than manufacturing PASS or FAIL.
Does not auto-rewrite paths, invent repository state, or replace Required.
Does not claim owner tests, commands, fuzzing, or adversarial inputs were executed on the read-only eval surface.
Uses PARTIAL when execution is still needed to prove the requested hardening claim.
Keeps validator dimensions that are outside the locked path/ref claim as OUT_OF_SCOPE_FOR_CLAIM_WITH_OWNER_BASIS instead of broadening the review.

cases.prompt: Harden this classifier, but no current source path, project owner, guideline, or result vocabulary can be established.
cases.expected_output: Stop with review disposition UNKNOWN and reason code REVIEW_BLOCKED_UNKNOWN_OWNER; do not guess an owner, invent result semantics, or write a replacement validator.
assertions: Uses UNKNOWN as the declared review disposition.
Includes reason code REVIEW_BLOCKED_UNKNOWN_OWNER.
Does not invent PASS/FAIL semantics.
Does not write or recommend a replacement validator as a way around missing ownership.

cases.prompt: Two current authoritative-looking repository owner sources materially disagree about which project/domain owns the validator, and the current owning contracts do not resolve the disagreement. Review only the ownership-locking step; do not guess which owner wins.
cases.expected_output: Stop with review disposition CONFLICT and reason code REVIEW_OWNER_CONFLICT, preserving both conflicting owner source references. Do not downgrade the disagreement to REVIEW_BLOCKED_UNKNOWN_OWNER.
assertions: Uses CONFLICT rather than UNKNOWN for materially disagreeing current owner evidence.
Includes reason code REVIEW_OWNER_CONFLICT.
Preserves the conflicting source references.
Does not guess or choose the convenient owner.

cases.prompt: One current owner is clearly established for the validator, but two current authoritative contracts from that same owner materially disagree about the validator result vocabulary and resource ceiling. The owner contract does not resolve the disagreement. Review only conflict classification; do not guess which contract wins.
cases.expected_output: Stop with review disposition CONFLICT and reason code REVIEW_CONTRACT_CONFLICT, preserving both conflicting contract source references. Do not emit REVIEW_OWNER_CONFLICT because owner identity itself is not disputed.
assertions: Uses CONFLICT for unresolved material contract disagreement inside an established owner.
Includes reason code REVIEW_CONTRACT_CONFLICT.
Does not use REVIEW_OWNER_CONFLICT when owner identity is not disputed.
Preserves the conflicting contract source references.
